title: High-throughput LC-MS/MS method for simultaneous quantification of drug metabolism and pharmacokinetic parameters in biological matrices
abstract: A targeted proteomics method using triple quadrupole LC-MS/MS for simultaneous quantification of DMPK parameters including metabolic stability, protein binding, and CYP inhibition from a single sample injection.

title: CRO matching platform with AI-driven service gap analysis for preclinical drug development outsourcing
abstract: A machine learning platform that matches biopharmaceutical companies with contract research organizations based on capability profiles, historical performance metrics, and service gap analysis.

title: Methods for tissue-specific quantification of therapeutic antibodies using peptide immunoaffinity LC-MS
abstract: A sensitive LC-MS method combining peptide immunoaffinity enrichment with targeted MRM for quantifying monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates in tissue homogenates.

title: Automated Dynabeads-based His-tag protein pull-down and digestion platform for proteomics sample preparation
abstract: An automated magnetic bead-based workflow for His-tagged protein enrichment, on-bead tryptic digestion, and direct LC-MS/MS analysis, suitable for preclinical pharmacokinetic studies.

title: Systems and methods for predicting drug-drug interaction liability using in vitro ADME data and machine learning
abstract: A computational platform integrating ADME assay data with machine learning models to predict CYP-mediated drug-drug interactions and guide preclinical development decisions.

title: Antibody-drug conjugate linker-payload stability profiling by LC-MS/MS with collision-induced dissociation
abstract: An MRM-based LC-MS/MS method for quantifying free payload release from ADC constructs in plasma and tissue, enabling linker stability assessment in preclinical models.

title: Bioanalytical method validation framework for protein therapeutics quantification in compliance with ICH M10 guidance
abstract: A comprehensive bioanalytical method validation framework for LC-MS-based protein therapeutic quantification addressing matrix effects, selectivity, and carryover per ICH M10.

title: Integrated preclinical CRO service coordination platform with real-time data visualization and regulatory submission tracking
abstract: A cloud-based platform for coordinating multi-site CRO services with integrated data visualization dashboards, milestone tracking, and automated regulatory submission document generation.

title: PROTAC degrader pharmacokinetic profiling using hybrid LBA-LC-MS/MS platform
abstract: A dual-platform approach combining ligand binding assays with LC-MS/MS to characterize the ADME properties of PROTAC molecules, including binary and ternary complex quantification.

title: Machine learning-based prediction of preclinical toxicity from chemical structure and in vitro assay data
abstract: A deep learning model trained on in vitro toxicity assay data and chemical descriptors to predict organ-specific toxicity endpoints prior to in vivo studies.

title: Automated tissue homogenization and protein extraction platform for high-throughput pharmacokinetic sample preparation
abstract: An automated liquid handling platform capable of processing up to 96 tissue samples per batch for protein extraction, including homogenization, centrifugation, and aliquot preparation.

title: Size-exclusion chromatography coupled to native mass spectrometry for intact protein analysis in biological matrices
abstract: A SEC-native MS method enabling direct analysis of intact therapeutic proteins from plasma and tissue samples without prior digestion, reducing sample preparation time by 60%.

title: CRISPR-based reporter cell lines for high-throughput CYP induction and inhibition screening in drug discovery
abstract: Engineered HepG2 cell lines with CRISPR-modified CYP promoters linked to fluorescent reporters, enabling simultaneous screening of CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C9, 2D6, and 3A4 induction.

title: Hybrid immunoaffinity-LC-MS/MS method for simultaneous quantification of bispecific antibody domains in preclinical species
abstract: A method using anti-idiotypic antibody capture combined with signature peptide MRM for quantifying individual domains of bispecific antibodies in mouse, rat, and monkey matrices.

title: Cloud-based bioanalytical data management system with automated batch acceptance and regulatory compliance checks
abstract: A GxP-compliant cloud platform for managing bioanalytical study data with automated batch acceptance criteria checking, audit trail, and electronic signature capabilities.
